coaching.headline: Aurora's Seedling, Fangtooth and Mini Prime plus a deathless Kira outweighed a mid lane that fed Skylar four kills and lost the outer tower.

flags.text: Aurora took Seedling, Fangtooth and Mini Prime, then two damn kills in the fight right after Mini Prime.
Kira finished deathless with the most gold of all ten, killing TwinBlast twice and Wukong once.
Sounder draft: Adele and Aurora as two tanks against a Kwang and Wukong dive with no tank.
Mid leaked: Skylar killed The Fey twice outside any detected fight, and the mid outer tower fell.

focus.title: Cover mid, keep the objective rhythm
focus.action: When Skylar gets ahead in mid, Aurora paths through mid before each river camp and objective, and The Fey plays behind the outer tower until Aurora arrives.

12.2.call: Lost two for none on mid with both deaths in the same second: Adele to Skylar, The Fey to Kwang. Two allies down at once means wait for the jungler before the next mid trade.

17.4.call: Zinx won the duo skirmish two for one, TwinBlast then Dekker, as the offlane outer tower fell after Adele died to Kwang; Mini Prime went allied next. When Kwang wins the offlane, call that tower lost and set up the next objective.

18.3.call: Three for none right after Mini Prime: Adele on Skylar, Aurora on Kwang and Wukong. Repeat that order: objective first, fight second.

544eeabf-e6af-4657-acbd-7757bdb3b19b: TwinBlast finished with zero kills and three deaths, two to this carry. When TwinBlast drops low after a trade, spend Pacifier's dash on the finish.
Took the gold buff camp three times. Once the enemy duo outer tower falls, rotate to mid before the next objective.
29325aad-bfc0-4c3c-a7eb-871471f2c87b: Mitigated 17619 damage, the most of all ten, and killed Skylar to open the fight after Mini Prime. Keep opening fights from the front the moment an objective is secured.
Two deaths to Kwang outside any detected fight; the offlane outer tower fell after the second. Before trading with Kwang, wait out Surge of the Heavens, the knock-up stun.
a286bef8-a1a8-4708-a42e-50953f377276: Cleared three enemy wards, the most of all ten, and died once against an own average of about six. Keep sweeping the duo side before every river camp.
Kill participation sat at 30%, with one assist. When Kira moves to a fight, go together with Ricochet's stun ready.
Killed TwinBlast and Dekker back to back, then fell to Dekker a second later. Before chasing Dekker, wait out Stasis Bomb and Ion Strike.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Objective damage 8655 and healing 8712, both the top of all ten. Repeat that next game: reach every objective pit with mid nearby.
Hero damage ran 403 per minute against an own average of 516. With Magnify finished, open on Skylar with Hoarfrost's root before Cryoseism.
The only death came to Skylar outside any detected fight, right after the Seedling take. After a Seedling, leave with mid or reset before Skylar shows.
ce185cdc-4f2c-4fee-bb94-5e35f44bb28f: Lowest hero damage of all ten: 256 per minute against an own average of 978, and zero kills. Shit output. Against Skylar, stack repeated orb hits before committing Fly Trap.
Fell to Kwang in the lost mid skirmish alongside Adele, three deaths in all with zero kills. Before trading mid, check that Kwang is visible on the offlane.

matchup: Duo with Zinx against TwinBlast and Dekker; the duo lost nobody before minute ten, the enemy duo lost one.
Field lane record into TwinBlast sits at 49% over 882 games: an even lane on paper that went clean.
build: Solaris heals for half the empowered hit's damage after each ability cast.
Ashbringer finished after the second TwinBlast kill; the first TwinBlast kill and the Wukong kill came before Solaris.
eternal: Vermis adds max-health physical damage on every third straight basic attack against one hero.
Vermis ranks last in this carry field; Lotus leans first.
Melting Point pays only against high-armor targets, and the enemy drafted no tank.
augment: Lenore: Shadow Glide refreshes the Nevermore cooldown and Nevermore deals bonus damage.
Lenore and Bringer Of Mercy are a toss-up in this carry field; sound keep.
crest: Pacifier's active dashes and empowers the next physical hit, much stronger on low-health targets.
Ortus is the field's Best crest for this carry; Pacifier, the most played, ranks behind.
improvement: No unmet defensive need shows for this lane, so no defensive swap is proven.
Imperator completes the most played core into TwinBlast, Solaris, Ashbringer, Imperator, at 62.3% over 77 games.
Ortus over Pacifier is the field-backed crest swap: a power and speed burst, giving up the dash.

matchup: Lane opponent Kwang dealt 18176 hero damage, the most of all ten, and took two kills here.
Took 9946 magical and 8342 physical damage from heroes, so both armor types mattered.
Field lane record into Kwang is 50% over 149 games, an even matchup.
build: Tainted Bastion finished after both deaths to Kwang, so both deaths came without that magical armor.
Tainted Bastion is the field's top adapt into Kwang, bought far more often than usual.
Elafrost brings physical armor and an empowered, slowing hit after each ability cast.
eternal: Krix raises max health by level; Cannibalism adds max health on every takedown.
Krix and Nihil are a toss-up for this offlane field; Voracity with Feeding Frenzy is the best Krix pair.
augment: Tyrant of Thorns is the field's Best offlane augment here: sound keep.
Tyrant of Thorns powers up Crown of Thorns and speeds Royal Flourish, but Royal Flourish no longer mesmerizes.
crest: Razorback's active adds both armor types and reflects part of hero damage as true damage.
Saphir's Mantle and Nyr Warboots tie at the top of this field; Razorback ranks behind both.
improvement: Into Kwang, finish Tainted Bastion first; the field's adapt into Kwang won 49.4% over 502 games.
The best offlane core is Fire Blossom, Tainted Guard, Forticus at 61.2% over 85 games.

matchup: Duo against TwinBlast and Dekker; Dekker brings Stasis Bomb and Ion Strike, both stuns.
Field lane record into Dekker is 48.8% over 639 games.
build: Marshal buffs nearby heroes with attack speed and on-hit damage, a fit next to Kira.
Tainted Scepter finished after the duo skirmish, so the two kills there came without the Scepter anti-heal.
Neither finished item carries armor, and the enemy drafted three physical damage dealers.
eternal: Exarch: healing or shielding an ally grants attack speed and bonus magical on-hit damage.
Exarch ranks third in this support field behind a Weald and Lotus toss-up; Illumination with Fervour is the best Exarch pair.
augment: Disc Of Demise sends Ricochet farther and cuts the Ricochet cooldown on each hero hit.
Disc Of Demise and Heal Matrix are a toss-up in this field; sound keep.
crest: Silentium's active silences a hero briefly; the passive raises the ward cap from two to three.
Silentium sits in a four-way toss-up for this support field; sound keep.
improvement: Dynamo adds physical armor and joins Marshal in the best support core, 57.9% over 95 games.
The most played core into Dekker, Marshal, Lunaria, Dynamo, won only 38.5%, so the broader core is the guide.

matchup: Jungle opponent Wukong finished with no kills and two deaths, one in the closing fight.
Field record into Wukong is 56.2% over 232 games, a favorable jungle matchup.
Skylar, with four kills on the mid lane, was a bigger threat than Wukong in this matchup.
build: Spirit Of Amir gives magical lifesteal in the jungle and extra ability damage to monsters.
Magnify and Tempest landed together late; the earlier Kwang kill ran on Spirit Of Amir alone.
Spirit Of Amir and Magnify carry no armor, while physical made up 3411 of 5733 hero damage taken.
eternal: Lotus grants random stats every two minutes and on each takedown; Flawless heals nearby allies on ability hits.
Nihil is the field's Best Eternal for this jungle; Lotus ranks second.
augment: Glacial Thorns adds rooting crystals at the base of Glacial Charge.
Glacial Thorns and Hypothermia are a toss-up in this field; sound keep.
crest: Tempest's active damages up to three nearby heroes each second and heals from that damage.
Epoch leans first in this jungle field; Tempest also ranks behind Saphir's Mantle, Typhoon and Winter's Fury.
improvement: The best jungle core is Prophecy, Orion, Magnify at 63.6% over 214 games; Magnify is already in.
Nihil over Lotus is the field-backed swap: Doom stacks power and armor in long fights, giving up the random stats.

matchup: Lane opponent Skylar's Hypercharge ignores part of bonus physical armor.
Took 10380 physical and 972 magical damage from heroes.
Field lane record into Skylar is 51.6% over 59 games.
build: Combustion bursts the target and nearby enemies on ability damage, the only completed item of the game.
No armor anywhere in the build despite the heavy physical damage taken.
eternal: Aion grants mana regeneration on casts and gold from spell damage to heroes.
Demiurge leans first in this mid field, Aion second; Bottomless Vial with Arcane Resonance is the best Aion pair.
augment: Wild Growth gives Bramble Patch more range.
Verdant Embrace is the field's Best mid augment; Wild Growth, the most played, ranks second.
crest: Obelisk's active is an enhanced basic attack that grows with souls collected.
Soulbearer is the field's Best crest here; Obelisk has too few games to lead.
improvement: The best mid core is Combustion, Wraith Leggings, Oblivion Crown at 63.3% over 577 games; Wraith Leggings is next.
Verdant Embrace over Wild Growth is the field-backed swap: Untamed Growth heals allies, giving up Bramble Patch range.
Soulbearer over Obelisk adds a shield and magical lifesteal on the active, giving up the empowered attack.

threats: Chain-CC risk (1 hard-CC abilities, ~0.5s of lockdown): Kwang Surge of the Heavens (knockup 0.5s). Don't group tight into it — stagger the engage and hold mobility/cleanse for the key one.
synergy: Little hard CC on our side — we can't force a pick. Play for poke/objectives and punish their cooldowns, don't flip coin-toss 5v5s.
Strong AoE/teamfight kit — group at choke points and fight on top of objectives.

ourKits.combo: Mercy for 3 Vengeance stacks, Dusk to purify for burst and slow, Shadow Glide to reposition, then Purge while gliding as needed.
ourKits.winCondition: Stack Vengeance with basics and abilities, then shred the team with Purge and reset Dusk and Shadow Glide on kills.
ourKits.passive: Nevermore periodically makes her next basic or Mercy fire a Raven that deals current-health damage in a small area.
ourKits.playWith: Peel that keeps divers off her while she channels Purge.
ourKits.playAgainst: During Purge she cannot attack or cast anything but Shadow Glide and is slowed, so CC her then. Avoid feeding takedowns since they reset Shadow Glide, and expect Purge's anti-heal.

ourKits.combo: Imperial Lash roots and dashes her to the furthest hero hit, Royal Flourish spins to Mesmerize, then Queen's Garden leaps in to root and drop a slowing Thornbush, with Iron Rose cast mid-combo for damage reduction
ourKits.winCondition: start fights with Lash or Queen's Garden and keep enemies stuck in the Thornbush while her Thorns make allies hit harder
ourKits.passive: damaging enemy heroes applies Thorns, and allies deal bonus true damage to Thorned enemies
ourKits.playWith: damage dealers who follow her engage and profit from Thorns bonus true damage
ourKits.playAgainst: sidestep Imperial Lash, since without it she has to walk in; once Queen's Garden is down she has no big lockdown, and walking out of the Thornbush limits its damage and slow; tenacity helps against her chained root and Mesmerize

ourKits.combo: Ricochet stun chain → Bad Medicine slows → basics to proc Triage Protocol → Infuse heal → Neural Regenesis on the ally about to die
ourKits.winCondition: keep allies alive with Infuse and Neural Regenesis while Ricochet stuns open picks
ourKits.passive: damaging heroes builds Triage Protocol; at max it gives decaying speed and stronger Infuse
ourKits.playWith: a carry she can pocket-heal and revive
ourKits.playAgainst: Infuse is aimed at allies, so dive her; bait Neural Regenesis before committing burst, avoid grouping in Ricochet's bounce chain, and buy anti-heal

ourKits.combo: Glacial Charge dashes in, Boreal Sweep slows, Hoarfrost roots enemies that touch the ring, then Cryoseism slows and stuns a target before it explodes
ourKits.winCondition: chain slow, root and stun to lock fights down while her Frost Storm grinds max-health damage
ourKits.passive: jumping mid-air leaps her and leaves a Replica that draws tower aggro; hitting a Hero or Monster 4 times summons a Frost Storm
ourKits.playWith: burst damage that turns her long CC chain into kills
ourKits.playAgainst: do not walk into the Hoarfrost ring while it persists; Cryoseism slows before it stuns, so cleanse or tenacity help, and spread so the explosion does not chain; she is weak once Glacial Charge is down

ourKits.combo: Bramble Patch slow → Untamed Growth zone → Harvest Nettles stacks → Fly Trap pull and stun
ourKits.winCondition: land Fly Trap on several heroes and follow with zone damage
ourKits.passive: takedowns spawn an Untamed Growth and give her movement speed
ourKits.playWith: engage that holds enemies near her Fly Trap and Bramble Patch
ourKits.playAgainst: she has no dash, so dive her once Fly Trap is spent; stay out of Bramble Patch and Untamed Growth zones, and buy magical armor

enemyKits.combo: Pole Vault leap in (Body) → High Impact slam slow → switch stance → Cyclebreaker spin and stun throw → Windsurge dash
enemyKits.winCondition: swap stances for the right tool and keep damaging enemies to spawn clones that add pressure
enemyKits.passive: Somersault lets him double jump into the air
enemyKits.playWith: teammates who fight alongside his clones and follow up on his stun
enemyKits.playAgainst: AoE clears his clones; avoid the Cyclebreaker throw stun, and wait out its damage-reduction spin before bursting him

enemyKits.combo: Judgement of the Heavens to tether, Surge of the Heavens into the Blade to knock up and stun, Light of the Heavens for true damage at the Blade, Fury of the Heavens to teleport and slow.
enemyKits.winCondition: Tether a target with the Blade, knock them up by dashing into it, and brawl with Energized basics that cut his cooldowns.
enemyKits.passive: Strike of the Heavens Energizes his basics after ability hits, adding attack speed, lightning damage and cooldown reduction.
enemyKits.playWith: Follow-up damage while he tethers and knocks up.
enemyKits.playAgainst: Watch where the Blade lands: it tethers, Surge into it knocks up, and Fury teleports him to it. Move away from the Blade and fight after Surge is used.

enemyKits.combo: Vortex Grenade slow → Vaporize pierce → Rocket Dash reposition → Ventilate barrage
enemyKits.winCondition: weave abilities for Gunslinger triple-shots and keep Rocket Dash up by hitting heroes
enemyKits.passive: casting an ability grants attack speed and makes the next basic fire three times
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline that creates space for him to keep shooting
enemyKits.playAgainst: Rocket Dash is his only escape and comes back faster when he hits heroes, so engage right after he uses it; Ventilate is a short channel worth interrupting

enemyKits.combo: Containment Fence traps a target, Stasis Bomb stuns from range, Ion Strike blasts to stun the center and slow the edge, and Photon Disruptor slows
enemyKits.winCondition: trap a target in the fence and chain stuns so the team collapses
enemyKits.passive: jumping mid-air fires Rocket Boots upward and speeds nearby allies; abilities cut its cooldown
enemyKits.playWith: burst that converts her stun and fence into a kill
enemyKits.playAgainst: dodge Stasis Bomb, whose stun gets longer the farther it travels; step out of the Ion Strike center during its delay; stay out of the fence ring or flank around it; tenacity shortens her stuns

enemyKits.combo: Plasma Grenade slow → Air Assault to hover with extra range → Hypercharge burst → Atomiser to finish a low target
enemyKits.winCondition: hover with Air Assault for extra basic range and shred with Hypercharge, refreshing it on takedowns
enemyKits.passive: extra jump height; kills make the target explode, much larger from enemy heroes
enemyKits.playWith: a frontline that holds enemies in place while she hovers and fires
enemyKits.playAgainst: Air Assault is her only reposition, so engage after it ends and she is back on the ground; dodge Plasma Grenade's slow and sidestep the Atomiser channel, which stops on the first hero hit

coachLean.headline: The closing fight after Mini Prime went 3-0 on Skylar, Kwang and Wukong, with Fangtooth already allied despite both outer towers falling.

flags.text: Two tanks, Adele and Aurora, into a draft with none; that shape wins 54.5% in 1.18 ranked.
Lost a mid lane fight 0-2: Skylar and Kwang killed Adele and The Fey, nothing back.
The enemy took the mid and offlane outer towers while the team took no structure all game.
The enemy took 12 river buffs to the team's 4; every Gold buff went allied, 4 to 0.

focus.action: Fight as five behind the two tanks: open with Queen's Garden, chain Hoarfrost and Ricochet, pay off with Purge and Fly Trap, and walk to river buffs together.

544eeabf-e6af-4657-acbd-7757bdb3b19b: Zero deaths with 3 kills and 10348 hero damage, two of the kills on TwinBlast; that is the carry standard to keep.
Next game, hold Purge for the lockdown: wait for Queen's Garden, Hoarfrost or Ricochet to land, then fire into the locked-down group.
29325aad-bfc0-4c3c-a7eb-871471f2c87b: Front line all game: 17619 damage mitigated, 15011 hero damage, and the first kill of the closing fight, on Skylar.
Three deaths, two to Kwang; next game, trade into Kwang only once Surge of the Heavens is spent, and save Queen's Garden to open team fights.
a286bef8-a1a8-4708-a42e-50953f377276: Support numbers held: 6 wards placed plus 3 cleared, 3484 healing, 30% kill participation and a single death.
Double kill on TwinBlast and Dekker in the 2-1 fight; next game, keep Ricochet to stun a diver on Kira or to chain right after Hoarfrost.
a0c393cc-1437-4bdc-8168-64676ce2166c: Objective engine: 8655 objective damage, Fangtooth and Mini Prime both allied, plus kills on Kwang and Wukong to close the last fight.
Next game, sweep the river buffs on each jungle clear, and drop Hoarfrost right as Queen's Garden ends to chain the root.
ce185cdc-4f2c-4fee-bb94-5e35f44bb28f: Only 4868 hero damage, the lowest on the team, with no kills and 3 deaths, two of those to Skylar.
Next game, throw Fly Trap after Queen's Garden or Hoarfrost lands to extend the lockdown, and shove mid before walking to river buffs.
